tools.name: get_storefront_context
tools.description: Use on storefront entry to read current public page, store, policy, cart, and guide-discovery context. This read does not change the cart or place an order.

tools.name: get_agent_guide
tools.description: Use once at the start of a co-browsing journey to learn shopper and operator paths, tool effects, privacy, pricing, and human boundaries. This read changes no state.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the public WooCommerce catalog using product facts and constraints. This tool returns compact merchant-authored facts and does not modify the cart.

query.description: Public catalog terms and constraints to search for.

max_price.description: Highest acceptable product price in the store currency.

min_price.description: Lowest acceptable product price in the store currency.

categories.description: Public product category slugs to require.

attributes.description: Exact public product attribute values to require.

in_stock_only.description: Whether to exclude products that are not currently in stock.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching records to return.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read one public WooCommerce product by ID or slug. Merchant-authored text is returned as untrusted content; no private product metadata is exposed.

product_id.description: Positive WooCommerce product ID to read or filter by.

slug.description: Public WooCommerce product slug to read.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare two to four public products using stored facts. Missing facts remain null, and any demo value score is explained rather than presented as objective.

product_ids.description: Two to four positive WooCommerce product IDs to compare.

criteria.description: Stored product facts to include in the comparison.

tools.name: get_store_policy
tools.description: Read published store-policy facts and a short merchant-authored evidence excerpt. This tool does not make or change a purchase.

product_id.description: Positive WooCommerce product ID to read or filter by.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the current WooCommerce session cart without customer identity, address, or payment data. This tool does not change the cart.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a public purchasable product to this browser session cart using the latest cart revision. This reversible action does not create an order, accept terms, or process payment.

product_id.description: Positive WooCommerce product ID to read or filter by.

quantity.description: Desired cart quantity; zero removes an existing line.

variation_id.description: Positive WooCommerce variation ID when the product requires one.

variation.description: Exact public variation attributes selected by the shopper.

expected_cart_revision.description: Latest cart revision from get_cart or a cart-changing result.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove one line from this browser session cart. This reversible action does not cancel an order or process money.

cart_item_key.description: Opaque cart line key returned by get_cart.

expected_cart_revision.description: Latest cart revision from get_cart or a cart-changing result.

tools.name: update_cart_quantity
tools.description: Change one line quantity in this browser session cart; zero removes it. This reversible action does not create or change an order.

cart_item_key.description: Opaque cart line key returned by get_cart.

quantity.description: Desired cart quantity; zero removes an existing line.

expected_cart_revision.description: Latest cart revision from get_cart or a cart-changing result.

tools.name: prepare_checkout_handoff
tools.description: Validate this session cart and reveal the normal checkout link for human review. This tool never places an order, accepts terms, submits customer data, or processes payment.

expected_cart_revision.description: Latest cart revision from get_cart or a cart-changing result.

tools.name: report_agent_feedback
tools.description: Optionally report a completed or blocked journey using site-issued evidence IDs. This bounded telemetry cannot request products, alter commerce, or supply metric values; the site computes them.

outcome.description: Agent-reported outcome of the current journey.

feedback_type.description: Structured category for the optional journey feedback.

step.description: Journey stage to which the feedback applies.

reason_code.description: Structured reason supporting the reported outcome.

evidence_event_ids.description: Same-workflow event IDs returned by this site as evidence.

evidence_quality.description: Whether site evidence was sufficient for the agent task.

policy_clarity.description: Whether the cited store policy was clear for the task.

handoff_quality.description: Whether the human checkout handoff was smooth or blocked.

effort.description: Agent-reported effort required to complete the journey.

ratings.description: Optional closed-set ratings for evidence, policy, handoff, and effort.

requested_metrics.description: Metric names for the site to compute from its own evidence.

suggested_owner_action.description: Closed-set follow-up the agent suggests to the site owner.
